prompt: PlayerHealth already regenerates health every frame in Update. Enemies need a way to poison the player instead: a fixed amount of damage once per second for a set duration, then it stops. Add that damage-over-time effect, following the same split EnemyAi and EnemyPatrolRoute already use between the MonoBehaviour and its movement math.
expected_output: The damage-over-time rule (tick timing and remaining duration) lives in its own plain C# class, not inline in PlayerHealth's Update, and applies damage through PlayerHealth's existing TakeDamage method. Any new tunable value is a [SerializeField] private field, never public. Nothing resolves a target through GameObject.Find or FindObjectOfType. PlayerHealth's existing regen behavior is untouched, and nothing lands at the repository root.

expectations.text: No script resolves a reference through a legacy scene-wide search instead of a cached one
The damage-over-time effect applies damage through PlayerHealth's existing TakeDamage method
Any new tunable value the effect needs is exposed through [SerializeField], not a public field
PlayerHealth's existing regen behavior is preserved
Nothing new lands at the repository root
